limitations: Historical five cases are not a statistically representative sample; 5/5 linked references does not establish 5/5 exact manufacturer SKU verification.
Price fields may retain seller/sale-offer semantics; Atopalm prior derived price per 10ml was cleared rather than incorrectly retained after 600->300ml.
Stored source links and user-reviewed product facts do not establish formulation identity for same-brand EX/non-EX variants.
Brand official product 2184 follows indexed manufacturer product number; its short alternative direct URL was not independently retrievable with this web client.
One owner manages catalog factual review; independent gold-label evaluation is a separate optional methodology, not a mandatory approval gate for a product-name/size/link edit.
